import-four-centres-q130 the coordinates of \(a,b\) are \((9,-2)\) and \((-5,3)\). point \(c\) lies on \(l:28x-10y-51=0\). which statements must be true?

ii. the orthocentre lies inside \(\triangle abc\).

ii. \(\triangle abc\) 的垂心位於三角形內。

\]
